text: Tariff Strategy: Strategic Protection, Not Isolation India’s tariff policy has evolved: Earlier Phase (2017-2020) e Higher tariffs to protect domestic industry e Import substitution focus Current Phase (2024 onward) e Selective tariff reductions where FTAs exist e High tariffs retained for sensitive sectors e Export-linked tariff rationalisation India is not de-globalising, but re-globalising on its own terms
